blocks.text: NEW YORK — “It’s mother,” were the first words uttered by Madonna as she opened the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards with her 2026 single “Bring Your Love” alongside her collaborator Sabrina Carpenter. If her aim was to bring the dance floor to the award show stage, she did exactly that — and then some, when Charli xcx emerged from a club bathroom to perform their reworked version of “Danceteria.” Around them?
